Repaired invalid condition types exposed when OR/AND stopped silently swallowing sub-conditions authored under "conditions": TalentContainsAny -> ATTACK_CLASS_IN. That repair walked only the ABILITY-level conditions and missed a SECOND TalentContainsAny nested in an effect's `filter` -- the same top-level-only trap that has now bitten this effort three times. The filter runs per attack against the attack card, so it is CARD_IS_CLASS over the talents.

"**Lightning Bond** - IF A LIGHTNING CARD WAS PITCHED TO PLAY THIS, this gets go again" was an ACTIVATE ability with a PITCH cost: an ability you activate by pitching, which is not what a bond is. A bond is a condition ON PLAY about what paid for the card, which PITCHED_FOR_THIS now answers (play._pitch_for_cost stamps the cards it took onto the card being played).

NOT implemented, and left as the closest available effect rather than silently wrong: the main clause is a DAMAGE REPLACEMENT ("if a Lightning or Elemental attack WOULD DEAL DAMAGE this combat chain, INSTEAD it deals that much damage plus 1"), and MODIFY_ATTACKS_THIS_TURN is a power modifier. The two differ wherever damage is not equal to power -- a pumped or prevented attack -- and the replacement also applies to arcane and non-attack damage. Definition of done: a damage-replacement primitive scoped to a class/talent exists.
